name: Nebius Academy - Inbound Lead Engine (local, no Sheets)

nodes.name: [1] Assessment completion
nodes.notes: SEAM: production points the assessment platform (Skillcheck, assumed) at this URL.

nodes.name: [2-7] Enrich, score, benchmark, route
nodes.notes: No LLM runs here. When a rep asks why a lead scored 82, this node answers.

nodes.name: [5] Route by band
nodes.notes: HOT: sales alert, 1 hour SLA. MQL: nurture. NEWSLETTER: no individual outreach.

nodes.name: [8] Build draft request
nodes.notes: The system prompt is byte stable across every lead, so it stays cacheable.

nodes.name: [8] Draft agent
nodes.notes: claude-sonnet-4-6. Constrained drafting, not open generation.

nodes.name: [8b] Parse draft, build forwardable request
nodes.notes: One assessment, two seats. This note is written for the seat that did not fill in the form.

nodes.name: [8b] Forwardable note agent
nodes.notes: Under 80 words, in the missing counterpart's language.

nodes.name: [9] Deterministic gate, build verifier request
nodes.notes: Layer 1: numbers, blocklist, comparative language, em dashes. Deterministic and free.

nodes.name: [9] LLM verifier
nodes.notes: Layer 2. Biased towards FAIL. A false FAIL costs one human glance.

nodes.name: [10] Lane on auto?
nodes.notes: Lanes graduate from manual to auto after 20 consecutive unedited approvals.

nodes.name: [10] Auto send with spot check
nodes.notes: SEAM: no real send. Production hands off to the ESP here.

nodes.name: [10b] Human review row
nodes.notes: Both trust mechanisms report here. Nothing sends.

nodes.name: [5] Newsletter only
nodes.notes: No individual outreach, so no committee logic and no tokens spent.

nodes.name: [12] Append to demand corpus
nodes.notes: IDEA THREE. Buyer language, unprompted, at the moment of purchase consideration.
